verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state physics is built-in via ammo.js (WebAssembly Bullet port) exposed through rigidbody, collision, and joint components, and that these same components work consistently across Editor, Engine, React, and Web Components — this covers rigid bodies and collisions out of the box. Raycasts are a standard Bullet/ammo.js physics-world feature implied by the physics system but not explicitly named in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of raycast API usage, and independent hands-on confirmation of physics reliability.
